_comment: Plasma Fusion performance budget: BACKLOG section 7 (2026-09-30-research/BACKLOG.md) and the EFFECTS.md 9.1 rows (2026-09-30-tablet/EFFECTS.md, aligned by PLAN.md resolution 5), with the owner's exceptions E12 and E13 (DECISIONS.md: all recommended). Lower is better for every metric. 'budget' holds the limit per geometry (virtual output size in device px @ scale; 'default' is the 1440x900 value, used when the source gives one value); 'exception' raises a row's limit by an owner decision (the gate prints its id); 'noise' is the regression margin against the stored baseline: a run regresses when its median exceeds the baseline's maximum by more than max(abs, rel * baseline median). Margins come from the spread of the perf-measure A/B runs (n=4 per arm). The idle rows keep wide margins until a baseline after BACKLOG M5 (CARD-1) exists; then re-record it and tighten them.

idle_fps.label: idle 30 s, system card visible: composited frames per s
idle_fps.source: EFFECTS 9.1: <= 1.2 / interval + 0.05 with the card visible (0.45 at the 3 s default); supersedes BACKLOG M5's 0.1 (PLAN.md LEAD-1 resolution 5)

idle_cpu_plasmashell.label: idle: plasmashell CPU % of a core

sweep_cpu_plasmashell.label: dock hover sweep 10 s: plasmashell CPU %

exception.reason: EFFECTS E12 (owner: recommended): keep magnification and accept up to the measured magnification-off cost + 3 points; magnification off measured 22.9 % at 1920x1200@4/3 (docs/parts/shell-dock.md, d4afee8, the lead's perf-dk harness). Re-measure in this gate with run.sh --dock-magnify off and update the number.

session_pss_settled.label: session PSS after settle (KWin at RSS)

gem_launcher_first_open.label: launcher first open: plasmashell GEM growth

gem_plasmashell_end.label: plasmashell GEM after one round of use

qs_first_frame_ms.label: quick settings: click -> first frame (incl. ~150 ms injection)

overview_late_frames.label: overview: late frames per open/close cycle

idle_fps_covered.label: idle 30 s, maximized window over the cards: frames per s
idle_fps_covered.source: EFFECTS 9.1 and X3: <= 0.1 with the system card covered

popup_render_p95_ms.label: KWin render p95 during launcher, quick settings and Alt+Tab
popup_render_p95_ms.source: BACKLOG 7 / EFFECTS 9.1 (value given for 1440x900; used for every geometry)

popup_late_frames.label: late frames per launcher or quick-settings opening
popup_late_frames.source: EFFECTS 9.1 missed vblanks per Fusion animation: 0 on AC (virtual output: render end after the target page flip)

sweep_panel_resizes.label: dock hover sweep: panel window resizes
sweep_panel_resizes.source: EFFECTS 9.1 (panel geometry fixed during hover; winmon.js geometry lines)

kwin_gpu_launcher_ms_per_frame.label: KWin GPU per frame, launcher open and close (sudo)

exception.reason: EFFECTS E13 (owner: recommended): accept 2.5 ms for the laptop launcher card, which keeps Full glass at 0.85 MP

kwin_gpu_launcher_ms_per_frame.source: EFFECTS 9.1 KWin GPU per animation frame; needs run.sh --kwin-gpu (pfstat.py reads KWin's private fdinfo with sudo -n)
